title: The Life of a Stickman 💔 (An Emotional Animated Short Film)
description:
We spend our entire lives chasing grand colors, endless wealth, and eternal monuments. But maybe... all you need to truly matter is a single, humble pencil line drawn with love.

"The Life of a Stickman" is an emotional animated short film exploring the beauty, tragedy, and legacy of existence through the eyes of Arthur—a stick figure born from a single graphite stroke on an artist's sketchbook page.

From the innocent wonder of his first wobbly steps, to discovering his soulmate Lily, to the heartbreaking arrival of the Eraser, and the final selfless act that transforms grief into an eternal blooming shelter. This story reminds us that life is not measured by how long our ink lasts, but by the love we leave behind on the page.
